verdict.rationale: smolagents is itself a Python SDK (pip-installable, importable classes like CodeAgent, ToolCallingAgent, Tool) with extensive first-party docs, guided tours, API reference, and GitHub examples showing developers building agents directly against its official API/SDK surface. It also supports broad model/provider integrations (LiteLLM, transformers, MCP) confirming it is the canonical way to build agentic apps in code. missing for 10: no independent third-party SDK conformance/versioning audit, and no explicit multi-language SDK (it's Python-only), so full 10/10 corroboration is absent.
